description: Write file storage code once. Run it against local files, S3, SFTP, or Azure. Python library with a unified Store API, swappable backends, and capability-gated methods.
rules: Use Store.read(path) for streaming reads, Store.write(path, content) for streaming writes (returns WriteResult), and Store.list_files(path) for directory listings.
Backends declare capabilities (LAZY_READ, ATOMIC_WRITE, ATOMIC_MOVE, METADATA, GLOB, ...). Query with store.supports(Capability.X); see FEATURES.md for the full matrix.

Install optional backends and extensions via pip extras. Backends: remote-store[s3], [s3-pyarrow], [sftp], [azure], [sql], [sql-query]. Extensions: [arrow] (PyArrow + Parquet), [otel] (tracing), [pydantic], [yaml], [dagster].

For async workloads, import AsyncStore from remote_store.aio. To cross the sync/async boundary, use SyncBackendAdapter (sync Backend → usable in async code, dispatched via asyncio.to_thread) or AsyncBackendSyncAdapter (async AsyncBackend → usable in sync code, runs on a dedicated daemon-thread event loop).
Built-in backends: LocalBackend, MemoryBackend, ReadOnlyHttpBackend, S3Backend, S3PyArrowBackend, SFTPBackend, AzureBackend, SQLBlobBackend, SQLQueryBackend.
Streaming reads: with store.read(path) as f: data = f.read(). Atomic writes: with store.open_atomic(path) as f: f.write(...). The destination appears only after the block exits cleanly.

Errors are typed in remote_store.errors and re-exported from remote_store. Base class is RemoteStoreError; subclasses are NotFound, AlreadyExists, PermissionDenied, InvalidPath, CapabilityNotSupported, DirectoryNotEmpty, BackendUnavailable. Backends never leak SDK-native exceptions.
Configuration loads from TOML, YAML, dict, or Pydantic models via Registry; ${ENV_VAR} placeholders are resolved and credentials are wrapped in Secret automatically.

Extensions live under remote_store.ext (always available): batch, cache, glob (portable fallback), integrity, observe (event hooks), partition, streams, transfer, write (client-side hashing). Optional via extras: arrow (PyArrow filesystem + Parquet datasets), otel (OpenTelemetry tracing), pydantic, yaml, dagster (IO manager).
